honest_boundary: This registry binds current repository bytes. It does not prove blinded evaluation, external custody, reviewer independence, or sealed release eligibility.

frozen_dev_v1.oracle_revision_boundary: Developer-authored before the canonical v1 Terra run.

frozen_dev_v2.oracle_revision_boundary: Explicit post-audit regression set; v1 Terra outputs were used to revise oracles.

frozen_dev_v3.oracle_revision_boundary: Post-approval regression derived from v2; eight raw-VBA recovery cases were migrated to typed save recovery.

deterministic_40_case_ablation.reproducibility_note: Does not reproduce on current code and must not be cited as current evidence. After ADR-011 put raw VBA behind parameter-bound approval, the eight raw-VBA recovery cases in v1 can no longer execute, so rerunning this dataset now yields full 32/40 with recovery_rate 0.0 and three failed thresholds. Retained as a historical artifact of the pre-approval runtime; cite post_approval_v3_deterministic_full instead.
deterministic_40_case_ablation.claim_scope: Historical pre-approval mechanism regression only; superseded, not current evidence.

terra_v1_representative_repeat3.claim_scope: Seven unique developer-visible cases with three correlated repeats; directional stability evidence only.

terra_v1_repeat3_semantic_audit.claim_scope: Response-SHA-bound semantic development audit; not independent human calibration.

terra_v2_post_audit_regression.claim_scope: Explicit post-audit regression; not unseen-model or blinded evidence.

post_approval_v3_deterministic_full.headline_results: full 40/40, no_recovery 32/40, no_planner 0/40, no_memory 40/40, no_context 40/40, no_tool_use_memory 40/40; 16/16 thresholds passed.
post_approval_v3_deterministic_full.reproducibility_note: Regenerated in-repo on the recorded code_revision, so a fresh clone can rerun the documented command and recompute these bytes. no_planner 0/40 is dominated by the context-budget guard refusing to call the model once plan-scoped tool filtering is removed; it demonstrates that plan-scoped tool catalogs are required for prompt budget, not that planning raises model quality.
post_approval_v3_deterministic_full.claim_scope: Post-approval production-path mechanism regression with a deterministic scripted provider; not model-quality, blinded, or sealed evidence.

raw_vba_approval_control_plane.claim_scope: Parameter-bound approval and server-owned exact execution; not suspended-turn resume or model-quality evidence.

superseded.legacy_registry_scope: Ten-case development reports remain historical diagnostics and are not current resume evidence.
